name: operator-(std::reverse_iterator)

declarations.code:
template <class Iter1, class Iter2>

typename reverse_iterator<Iter>::difference_type

operator-(const reverse_iterator<Iter1> &lhs,

    const reverse_iterator<Iter2> &rhs);

intro: Returns the distance between two iterator adaptors.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
lhs, rhs

 -

 iterator adaptors to compute the difference of

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: operator- returns rhs.base() - lhs.base() rather than lhs.base() - rhs.base() because this is a reverse iterator.

summary: Returns the distance between two iterator adaptors.
